_comment: Polished terrazzo: chips of stone set in a cement binder, then ground flat and polished, so the floor shows each chip cut through (ambientCG Terrazzo019L, CC0; tagged beige, floor, stone, terrazzo; 80 x 80 cm, so meters_per_tile 0.8 from the source and tag s1, not the wish list's s01; the L variant is the largest of the asset's three sizes). A warm beige: tan and cream chips from under 1 cm to about 6 cm in a beige matrix, polished (roughness map mean 0.28). It is one substance, a composite stone, not an assembly (D1): the chips are part of the matter; divider strips and floor tiles are geometry. Opaque: a solid dielectric. Carries every relevant wear layer at 0 (C1): scratches (overlay 1, damage), scuffs, dust as a deposit (Phase10), gated by the Grime mask. Built for the platform's generated architectural Set (261004_R_PlatformSetMaterialAsks.md, A5).
name: Terrazzo_Polished_Clean_Base_s1_v01

sources.note: only the IOR and metalness are taken, for the cement binder; colour and roughness are the scan's. Physically Based has no terrazzo entry. The scan's mean linear albedo is about 0.35, 0.27, 0.18, a warm beige, left as scanned.
